seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player: arrows 1-4 move 3 cells, blocked by board edge and two inferred invisible walls (27,54,3,3),(33,27,12,3).
Kick: if the player's next rect overlaps a block, the player stays and the block slides 3/step, pushing every block it hits as a chain.
The whole group stops when any member would hit a wall/edge/player or a socket interior it does not fit (border overlap allowed; player passes over sockets).
Click on a block: the block becomes the player (takes its rect), old player vanishes; tokens renamed token_i by (y,x). Sockets/portal static.
